verdict.rationale: Rippling's payroll page documents first-party integration with Xero, QuickBooks, and NetSuite, which covers the core of the story. The evidence never says that payroll journal entries specifically are posted, or that the sync runs automatically after each pay run. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of payroll journal entry export or GL mapping, confirmation that the sync is automatic or recurring per pay run, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync payroll journal entries automatically to my accounting software like QuickBooks or Xero
